add_field.title: Add a field
add_field.description: Fields added so far: {count}. Field keys are stored verbatim in every record - prefer a short key (e.g. "sys" instead of "systolic_pressure") for record types you plan to log frequently via automations.

reconfigure_add_field.title: Add a field
reconfigure_add_field.description: Fields added so far: {count}. Field keys are stored verbatim in every record - prefer a short key (e.g. "sys" instead of "systolic_pressure") for record types you plan to log frequently via automations.

edit_field_label.title: Edit field label
edit_field_label.description: The field's key ({key}) - used in automations - is not affected by this.

change_field_key.title: Change field key
change_field_key.description: Current key: {key}. Changing it updates every stored record to match, but any automation or dashboard card that references the old key by name will silently stop working - you'll need to update those yourself.

data.confirm: I understand this may break existing automations/dashboards referencing the old key

delete_field.title: Delete field
delete_field.description: Delete "{label}" ({key})? Existing stored records keep their data, but any automation or dashboard card that still submits this field will start failing - you'll need to update those yourself.

data.confirm: I understand this may break existing automations/dashboards

change_type_key.title: Change record type key
change_type_key.description: Current key: {key} (for "{name}"). Changing it moves all stored records and media to match, but any automation or dashboard card that references the old key (e.g. `record_type: {key}`) will silently stop working - you'll need to update those yourself.

data.confirm: I understand this may break existing automations/dashboards referencing the old key

set_retention.title: Retention for {name}
set_retention.description: Records are kept forever by default. Optionally set a retention period, a maximum record count, or the threshold at which a warning is raised.

export_data.title: Export data
export_data.description: Download this record type's records as a CSV file.

import_data.title: Import data
import_data.description: Upload a CSV file to import records into this record type. Rows whose ID already exists are skipped, not overwritten - as are rows with no ID that exactly match an existing record's timestamp and data.

error.already_exists: A record type with this name already exists.
error.invalid_key: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single underscores only.
error.rename_failed: The record type could not be renamed. Check the logs and try again.
error.reserved_key: This key is reserved (id, timestamp, record_type) and cannot be used.
error.duplicate_key: This key is already used by this record type.
error.options_required: Provide at least one option for select fields.
error.confirmation_required: You must confirm you understand the risk before proceeding.
error.file_not_found: The uploaded file could not be read - please try uploading it again.
